events_coordinates_valid.name: events_coordinates_valid
events_coordinates_valid.value: ("events"."latitude" IS NULL AND "events"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("events"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "events"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

resale_listings_kind_fields.name: resale_listings_kind_fields
resale_listings_kind_fields.value: ("resale_listings"."kind" = 'platform' AND "resale_listings"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "resale_listings"."event_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("resale_listings"."kind" = 'external' AND "resale_listings"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "resale_listings"."external_event_name" IS NOT NULL AND "resale_listings"."external_starts_at" IS NOT NULL)

resale_listings_live_has_event.name: resale_listings_live_has_event
resale_listings_live_has_event.value: "resale_listings"."status" NOT IN ('active', 'sold') OR "resale_listings"."event_id" IS NOT NULL
